title: Church Accountability
definition: Church Accountability is the loving responsibility believers have to encourage, correct, restore, and watch over one another under Christ.
summary: Church Accountability is the loving responsibility believers have to help one another walk faithfully with Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ shepherds His people through His Word, His Spirit, and the loving ministry of the body.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on mutual watchfulness. Accountability is not control, spying, or shame; it is truth-speaking love that helps believers persevere. It includes encouragement, correction, confession, warning, prayer, and restoration.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because sin grows in secrecy and pride resists correction. Accountability gives practical shape to the command to exhort one another. It protects believers from isolation and helps the church become a community where holiness is pursued together.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Invite trusted believers to speak into your life before crisis comes. Correct others gently and biblically, not harshly or vaguely. Build relationships where confession and encouragement are normal.
